title: Implementation of an extension point
description: An implementation (schema/extension-implementations/<name without namespace>.json): a public class of the package that implements the interface of an extension point of the package or of a required one, with the values of the filter fields it is meant for.

extensionPoint.description: The extension point, of the package or of a package it requires.

class.description: A public class of the package with a public constructor without parameters that implements the interface of the extension point.

filters.description: Values per filter field: single values, ranges and patterns as in roles. Every filter field without default is given; * matches all values.

order.description: Place in the order of a multiple extension point; equal numbers are ordered by package ID and name. Default 0.
